description: An example: the Vivado flow on a build server, the card on another. Copy it outside the repository, e.g. ~/.config/tritonchip-fpga-harness/hosts.json, and fill in your own servers. Every value is one shell-safe token.

build.description: Vivado/Vitis and the U280 platform; no card. Python 3.9 or later.

cluster-1.description: A batch cluster instead of one machine: 'ssh' is its login node, the link runs as an LSF job on a node (README 11.3). workspace and state_dir are on the file system the nodes share; list cluster-2, cluster-3 with their own directories to run several links at once.

card.description: The card, XRT, and the ArchBench interpreter (PyTorch, Triton, tnca).
